title: Step 12
coreMove: Turn insight about a harmful habit into a repeatable recovery process with accountability.
sourcePressure: Frames change as recovery process: destructive leadership habits require admission, repeated practice, accountability, and help, not isolated insight.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Borrowing recovery language as metaphor only, or treating admission as the whole change.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.stakes: understanding the shortcut is not recovery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he asks the cellar tech to check his valve seal every Friday for a month
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a valve seal tag beside a tasting glass

exampleSpecs.stakes: staff need repeated proof, not one apology
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she brings a printed agenda with the first five minutes reserved for bad news without punishment
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an agenda page beside a school radio

exampleSpecs.audience: owner asking sibling for help with temper
exampleSpecs.stakes: support strengthens responsibility when the old reflex returns
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he gives his sibling a phrase to interrupt him before dinner rush arguments escalate
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a cash drawer key beside a prep ticket

exampleSpecs.audience: repair-night coordinator who keeps taking receivers out of volunteers' hands
exampleSpecs.stakes: volunteers never build skill if every hard solder joint gets taken over
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the coordinator reviews the sign-up sheet and assigns himself only question-asking shifts while a volunteer solders the next receiver lead
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a solder spool beside a volunteer sign-up sheet

exampleSpecs.audience: lead docent recovering from lecture dominance
exampleSpecs.stakes: new behavior must be visible to learners
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she times her own silence and lets the trainee answer the visitor's question first
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a pocket timer beside a gallery map

exampleSpecs.stakes: accountability needs others who can name the relapse
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she sends the medication schedule with edit access instead of a final command
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a medication chart beside a shared login note

skillTargets: ask for help without outsourcing responsibility

tryThisNowSpec: Choose one leadership habit you already understand and schedule the next accountable practice that would prove change to someone else.
